observables.name: large_electrode_anisotropy_conclusion

source_refs.quote: 1. For the first time the neutron yield and neutron emission anisotropy have been measured for PF shots performed at about 1 MJ discharge energy. 2. Neutron yield of the order of 2×1011 neutrons/shot was registered in the series of shots carried out within the PF- 1000 facility equipped with new (large) electrodes. 3. Angular distribution of the neutron emission is more isotropic in the PF-1000 facility than that observed in other PF experiments. 4. Noticeable fast ion emission was observed only in the discharges carried out at a relatively low filling pressure p0 (1–2) Torrs.
